name: Left Piece Hanging
desc: Your move leaves your own piece en prise, unforced (net material loss, non-trade).

name: Greedy Capture
desc: A capture that loses material — the capturing piece is lost or a stronger move existed (net negative, NOT an even trade).

name: Premature Trade
desc: An even exchange made at the wrong moment — trading off your best piece and surrendering an advantage.

name: Missed Hanging Piece
desc: An enemy piece was free to capture; you didn't take it.
mech: missed-material high via capture, own-hang low

name: Missed Tactic
desc: Missed a fork, pin, skewer, or winning combination (non-mating, non-simple-capture).

name: Missed Check or Mate
desc: A forcing check or forced mate was available; you played something quieter.

name: Pointless Check
desc: You gave a futile check that achieves nothing and often loses material.

name: King Safety Error
desc: Neglected or exposed your king — abandoned defense, walked into danger, weakened the shelter.

name: Passive Play
desc: Drifting / aimless moves with no plan when the position demanded action.
mech: positional, low material swing, no concrete action

name: Endgame Technique
desc: King-and-pawn / promotion / tempo technique error in the endgame.

name: Unsound Aggression
desc: An unsound sacrifice or premature attack that doesn't work.
